messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "neural tube defects"
set: ["neural tube defects", "may increase risk of neural tube defects in early pregnancy", "major birth defects", "tube feeding needed", "complications may require tube feeding", "thin tube placed in back", "limited human data on birth defects", "may be given through feeding tube", "some studies report increases in specific defects", "no link to major birth defects or miscarriage", "can harm an unborn baby or cause birth defects", "no overall difference in risk of major birth defects", "this mixture can be given through a nasogastric (ng) feeding tube", "catheter-tipped syringe was used to give the mixture through the tube", "no overall difference in risk of major birth defects compared to background rate", "birth defect affecting the spine"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
